title: Privacy notice
intro: This notice tells you what data Yanig uses, where it goes and how you can delete it.

sections.title: In short
items: Yanig has no accounts. It does not ask for your name, email or location.
Yanig does not use cookies, ads or trackers.
Your settings stay in your browser.

sections.title: What stays on your device
paragraphs: Yanig saves these things in the local storage (localStorage) of your browser:
items: The date you closed the "Add to home screen" message
after: This data does not leave your device. Yanig cannot see it.
Your browser also keeps a copy of pages and data that you opened. This lets those pages work without internet.

sections.title: What your browser asks for
paragraphs: To show the pages, your browser connects to other services. Each service can see your IP address and browser type, like any website.
items: Earthquake data: your browser asks USGS (United States), GeoNet (New Zealand) and BMKG (Indonesia) directly.
Map: your browser loads the map images (tiles) from OpenStreetMap.
News: your browser asks the Yanig server. The Yanig server asks NewsAPI. NewsAPI does not see your IP address.
News pictures: the pictures in news articles load from the news sites that publish them.
Links: when you open a link to another website, the privacy rules of that website apply.

sections.title: Hosting
paragraphs: Yanig runs on Vercel. Like most hosts, Vercel can keep basic request logs, for example your IP address and the time of the request.

sections.title: Your choices
items: To delete your saved settings and checklist, clear the site data for Yanig in your browser settings.
To remove the installed app, remove Yanig from your home screen.
You can use Yanig without installing it.

sections.title: Children
paragraphs: Yanig does not collect personal data from anyone, children included.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: If this notice changes, the date at the top of this page changes too.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: Rafael Race made Yanig. For questions, open an issue on the Yanig page on GitHub.
